members.name: banking_intents
members.instructions: Which intent does this customer message to a digital bank's support chat express? Pick the single most specific intent.

criteria.activate_my_card: how to activate / start using a new card that has arrived
criteria.age_limit: minimum age or age requirement to open an account
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: anything involving Apple Pay, Google Pay, Apple Watch or mobile wallets: adding a card, paying, or topping up via a wallet, including when top-up via a wallet is not working
criteria.atm_support: finding ATMs, which ATMs can be used, ATM locations
criteria.automatic_top_up: setting up, enabling or disabling automatic top-ups
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: a bank transfer made into the account (or just made) that is not showing in the balance / anywhere; balance not updated yet, taking long to update
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: deposit of cash or cheque, or 'deposited some money', not showing up in the balance yet
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: cannot add or transfer to a beneficiary / recipient not allowed
criteria.cancel_transfer: cancelling or reversing a bank transfer (money sent to a person/account), not purchases
criteria.card_about_to_expire: card expiring soon, renewing or replacing an expiring card
criteria.card_acceptance: where the card is accepted, merchants or places that take the card
criteria.card_arrival: tracking a card ordered that has not yet arrived, where is my card, delivery late
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: how long card delivery takes, expected delivery time or fees for delivery
criteria.card_linking: linking / connecting an existing card to the app or account
criteria.card_not_working: card does not work / stopped working (generic, not lost or contactless)
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: a fee charged specifically on a card payment (e.g. foreign card payment fee)
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: a card purchase / payment the customer does not recognise, unknown charge, or a payment they say they did not make (a merchant transaction they cannot identify)
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: wrong exchange rate applied to a card payment abroad
criteria.card_swallowed: ATM machine kept / swallowed the card
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: fee or charge for withdrawing cash
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: a cash withdrawal / ATM withdrawal, or a cash amount shown in the app, that the customer did not make or receive (e.g. someone withdrew money with their card, app shows cash balance they did not get)
criteria.change_pin: changing or setting the PIN, how to change PIN
criteria.compromised_card: card or account being used by someone else without knowledge, suspected fraud on the card, card details stolen
criteria.country_support: which countries the service / card is available in
criteria.declined_card_payment: card payment was declined or rejected
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: cash withdrawal at an ATM declined, or the card will not work / not give money at an ATM
criteria.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: a direct debit payment the customer does not recognise; also the vague phrasings 'unauthorized charge' or 'charged by mistake' on the statement
criteria.edit_personal_details: changing personal details such as name, address, phone, email
criteria.exchange_rate: what exchange rate is used, current exchange rates
criteria.exchange_via_app: exchanging currencies in the app, including which currencies are available to exchange
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: an unexpected extra charge or small extra amount taken on a statement or on the card, why was I charged
criteria.fiat_currency_support: which fiat currencies are supported, including for exchange and holding, and whether a specific currency is supported
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: how to get a disposable virtual card
criteria.get_physical_card: asking whether and how to obtain a physical card, wanting a physical card rather than virtual
criteria.getting_spare_card: getting a second or spare or additional card, including for a family member, limit on number of cards
criteria.getting_virtual_card: how to get a (non-disposable) virtual card
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: card lost, stolen, misplaced, needing to find/retrieve or freeze/block a lost or stolen card immediately
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: phone lost or stolen, security of the account
criteria.order_physical_card: where / how to order a (physical) card, placing an order for a card
criteria.passcode_forgotten: forgot passcode / password to the app
criteria.pending_transfer: a transfer that appears as pending in the app, why is it pending
criteria.pin_blocked: PIN blocked after wrong attempts, unblocking PIN
criteria.receiving_money: how to receive money into the account, incoming payments, salary
criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: a refund that was promised or requested (including from a seller) has not arrived / not been returned yet
criteria.request_refund: asking for a refund, returning goods, cancelling a purchase / wanting money back from a merchant purchase
criteria.reverted_card_payment?: a card payment that was reverted / did not go through with the merchant, where money was deducted first and then returned or reversed
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: which cards / payment methods are accepted (including to add funds or top up), and which currencies are supported
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: fee for topping up by bank transfer
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: fee for topping up by card
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: topping up using cash or cheque
criteria.top_up_reverted: a top-up into the account that was reverted / returned / cancelled
criteria.topping_up_by_card: topping up or transferring money into the account using a credit/debit card (how to, is it possible), not asking which cards are accepted
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: charged twice for the same transaction, duplicate charge
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: a fee charged on a transfer, including fees when sending money abroad / international transfers, increased or unexpected fees
criteria.transfer_into_account: ways to add money / transfer money into the account, how to fund the account from another bank or source
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: a transfer the customer sent that the recipient (friend, other person, their own other account) has not received yet, not come through, not showing up; correct details were given
criteria.transfer_timing: asking how long a transfer takes in general or when it will arrive, before or without saying it is missing
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: identity verification failed / cannot verify identity
criteria.verify_my_identity: how to go through identity verification, what documents or steps are needed to verify
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: verifying or explaining where money / funds come from (source of funds, origin of a deposit or top-up, tracing where funds flow from)
criteria.verify_top_up: verifying a top-up: verification code / check needed for a card top-up or card transfer into the account, not receiving the code
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: whether cards are Visa or Mastercard, choosing network
criteria.why_verify_identity: why identity verification is needed, whether one has to verify who they are, is verification required
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: received the wrong amount of cash from an ATM: less or more than requested, or the ATM gave less than the balance shows was withdrawn
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: wrong exchange rate applied to a cash withdrawal
